independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for container padding, gap and radius.

intent: Hold content at any level, from a group of controls to a whole page, with one element whose radius and padding nest concentrically: a nested container takes its parent's radius minus its padding, so every curve down to the controls follows the outer one

attributes.name: preset
attributes.description: The starting geometry, flow and surface: group (a wrapping row, 1u), collection (a stack, 2u; the default), card (a card surface, 4u), panel (the panel fill, square), region (square, 8u), page (square, 8u, a centered 72rem column).

attributes.name: padding
attributes.description: The card ladder level, xs 2u, sm 3u, md 4u, lg 5u, xl 6u; replaces the preset level.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: stack (a column), row (one line), wrap (a wrapping row). Default: the preset's.

attributes.name: surface
attributes.description: none, panel, card, raised: the elevation level (fill and shadow). Default: the preset's.

attributes.name: levels
attributes.description: On a root: the nested levels below it. The padding splits evenly, (R − control radius) / levels, so every curve down to the controls is concentric.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gutter between children in units of u, 0…8 in 0.5 steps. Default: the container level's padding.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Radius as a magnitude of the concentric radius, 0…1 in 0.05 steps: 1 concentric (default: the theme's radius-card), 0 square. Lets the container be sharper than fully rounded contents.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

constraints: CSS-only tag: no script, nothing to register. preset (group, collection, card, panel, region, page) sets the starting geometry, flow and surface; layout and surface override it.

Nesting: a root keeps its preset geometry; a nested ui-container is concentric with its parent (R = R_parent − p_parent); a container holding containers keeps the ratio (container-ratio) for them, or splits evenly with levels; a leaf fits its controls. Areas (panel, region, page) are square and restart the chain. Up to 6 levels.
Adds no role: add role/aria-label (e.g. role=region) when it should be a landmark or group.

avoidWhen.reason: A container only lays out and nests its children.

props: radius?: number // Group, collection, card: the radius as a magnitude of the concentric radius, 0 … 1 in 0.05 steps (1 concentric, 0 square).
preset?: ContainerPreset = 'collection' // group, collection (default), card, panel, region, page: the starting geometry, flow and surface.
padding?: CardPadding // The card ladder level: xs 2u, sm 3u, md 4u, lg 5u, xl 6u.
layout?: 'stack' | 'row' | 'wrap' // stack (column), row, wrap. Default: the preset's.
surface?: 'none' | 'panel' | 'card' | 'raised' // none, panel, card, raised: the elevation level. Default: the preset's.
levels?: number // Nested levels below this root: the padding splits evenly so every curve down to the controls is concentric.
